note: Reference pack: farm machinery history and technology (tractors, safety, guidance, vision, satellite, robots, drying, spraying). Site-neutral. Some dates are approximate or unverified; see notes.

things.name: the Ivel Agricultural Motor
things.who: built by Dan Albone at Biggleswade, the first successful light petrol tractor in Britain

things.name: the Fordson Model F tractor
things.who: made by Henry Ford and Son; thousands were ordered by the British government in 1917 for wartime food production

things.name: the Ferguson-Ford handshake agreement
things.who: an agreement between Harry Ferguson and Henry Ford to build tractors with the three-point linkage

things.name: the Ferguson-Brown Type A tractor
things.who: designed by Harry Ferguson and built by David Brown

things.name: the Ferguson TE20 tractor
things.who: made in Coventry by Harry Ferguson's company, about half a million in all

things.name: the three-point linkage
things.who: developed by Harry Ferguson; first patented in the 1920s (exact year to be checked)

things.name: the Swedish requirement for tractor protective structures
things.who: an early national rule on roll-over protection (year to be checked)

things.name: the British regulations requiring tractor safety cabs
buried-wire vehicle guidance
things.who: researched for farm tractors from the mid-1950s onwards

things.name: the excess green index
things.who: introduced for separating plants from soil in images by Woebbecke and colleagues

things.name: machine-vision weed control
things.who: developed from row-following hoes in the 1990s to deep-learning sprayers in the 2010s

things.name: full operation of GPS
things.who: the US satellite navigation system, declared fully operational in 1995

things.name: the end of GPS selective availability
things.who: the US stopped deliberately degrading civilian GPS in May 2000

things.name: RTK auto-steer for tractors
things.who: centimetre-accurate satellite steering, common on larger farms from the 2000s

things.name: the Hands Free Hectare
things.who: a Harper Adams University project with Precision Decisions that grew and harvested a barley crop with no person working in the field

things.name: autonomous farm robots
things.who: small field robots and driverless tractors from several companies

things.name: grain drying
things.who: mechanical grain drying became common in Britain with combine harvesting from the mid-twentieth century

things.name: spray drift control
things.who: low-drift nozzles and buffer-zone rules developed in the 1990s

people.name: Harry Ferguson
people.who: the County Down engineer who invented the three-point linkage and the Ferguson tractor

made a handshake agreement with Henry Ford
began building the TE20 in Coventry

people.who: a Biggleswade bicycle maker who built the Ivel Agricultural Motor

people.who: the American motor manufacturer whose firm made the Fordson tractor
events: began Fordson tractor production for wartime Britain
made a handshake agreement with Harry Ferguson

people.name: David Brown
people.who: the Huddersfield gearmaker who built Harry Ferguson's first production tractors
